title: Copse Corner
subtitle: Copse, 2021. Mercedes and Red Bull, two championship cars, one corner—and a collision the factories would argue about for months.

content.text: The collision heard around the world. It wasn't just an accident; it was two championship machines meeting where the track narrows—Mercedes' floor advantage against Red Bull's high-downforce knife, neither driver willing to yield the inside line that Sunday.

Think of it like a basketball pick-and-roll gone wrong: two athletes executing the same play, each convinced the other broke the unwritten rule. The stewards would argue for days; the factories would file briefs in air.
This is not tennis. This is life and death.
content.author: Toto Wolff
